sentences.en: Boeing developed a flying boat for the Maritime Self-Defense Force.
sentences.zh: 波音为海上自卫队开发了一款水上飞机。

sentences.en: He pleaded self-defense at the trial and went scot-free.
sentences.zh: 他在庭审中以自卫为由为自己辩护，并未受到任何处罚。

sentences.en: She took night classes in the art of self-defense.
sentences.zh: 她报名参加了防身术夜校课程。
